title: fix(lambda-nodejs): use direct spawn for local bundling

target.summary: Executing spawn steps directly via exec fails on Windows when invoking .cmd shims (such as npx.cmd). Direct spawnSync cannot resolve batch file shims, failing with EINVAL and crashing local bundling.
notes: faulty statement: directly spawns commands without handling Windows .cmd shims
helper producing the .cmd shim command array executed by direct spawn
definition of tryBundle executing the spawn steps
